title: MCP Unity + Cursor + GPT Plus + Gemini Pro
author: khull123
selftext:
Hello AIgameDevs,

As the title says I have these tools but for some reason cursor so quickly hits the usage limit (auto mode) I can't add free gemini or gpt models, rather it says invalid name for the model or tells me agent and editor doesn't work with it this way. I wanted to see cursor experience but I think after 2 implementation I hit the wall. I will really appreciate if you guys share your workflows (should I switch models based on the prompts?) (or cursor hit the wall cuz of MCP usage?) and any help on the cursor.

Thanks!

comments.author: Bitter-Tip5178
comments.body: Claude code all the way forget the rest

replies.author: khull123
replies.body: I deleted cursor, free version was so quickly finished I'm not sure even how. I tried Gemini and gpt and codex separate, they were meh, now antigravity I'm using it looks okay, I will try bezi as well later. Also I tried coplay it looks promising but not there yet or I couldn't lead it well. This agent skills, etc requires time I feel like I will build the demo by myself faster.

replies.author: Bitter-Tip5178
replies.body: I just use Claude code + godot mcp but for unity I heard coplay is great. I would try just plain mcp + Claude code and just pay for the max plan. Worth it if you’re serious

replies.author: khull123
replies.body:
How much we are talking about? I can see in free versions Claude's models are quite good but sometimes some other models excel better at certain other things. 

Claude seems to be the most expensive of all AI?

replies.author: Bitter-Tip5178
replies.body: I pay $100/m and use opus 4.5 always. I haven’t run into limits yet!

replies.author: lovable-fried-donut
replies.body: Same. It’s not cheap but I’ve never gotten close to my limits and the output is 10x better than what codex gives me. Bezi didn’t impress me, nothing I couldn’t do with ClaudeCode and MCP and a few editor tools (that Claude wrote lol)
